subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 08/11] mountd: retry export attributes that fail to resolve for a passing reason

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to retry export attributes that fail to resolve due to a passing reason, such as a temporary error or an inability to determine whether a path is exportable. The patch introduces a new return value of EAGAIN for cases where the decision cannot be made immediately, and keeps EINVAL for genuine errors. This change allows the mountd service to recover from temporary issues and improve its ability to handle re-exported NFS mounts.
